item.title: Self-Hosted Travel Planners in 2026: TREK vs Wanderer vs AdventureLog
item.description: You plan a two-week trip across four countries, and your entire itinerary lives inside a service that can change its pricing, shut down, or hand your location history to an advertiser. That is the actual trade you make with most travel apps. Self-hosting a trip planner flips it: your bookings, GPX tracks, budgets and photos stay on a box you control, and no company can decide your travel log is a data asset to monetize.

item.title: Self-Hosted Fitness & Workout Tracking Platforms: Wger vs Workout Tracker vs FitTrackee
item.description:
Why Self-Host Your Fitness Tracker?

Your health and fitness data is among the most personal information you generate. Commercial fitness apps collect detailed profiles of your activity patterns, heart rate zones, workout preferences, and even sleep data — then monetize that information through targeted advertising or sell it to data brokers. Self-hosting your fitness tracker puts you back in control.
